title: YOLO Cottage & Carriage | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perfectly positioned on the south side of 30A, this exceptional Rosemary Beach retreat offers direct, private beach access and breathtaking Gulf views from nearly every level. Designed with elegance and comfort in mind, the main home features four beautifully appointed bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with a spa-inspired bath and wraparound balcony. The top-floor living area stuns with panoramic ocean views, an open-concept layout, and a massive balcony complete with a swinging daybed—ideal for sunset cocktails or lazy afternoons. Just steps from the sand via a private gate to Beach Access A, the resort-style courtyard is a true showpiece, offering a heated pool and spa, outdoor fireplace, and alfresco dining for fourteen. Guests enjoy full access to Rosemary Beach’s coveted amenities, including four community pools, a fitness center with classes and massage services, and the renowned Racquet Club. A separate carriage house adds flexibility for extended family or friends, featuring Gulf views, vaulted ceilings, a full kitchen, and a cozy loft space perfect for kids. With seven adult bikes included and all of Rosemary’s charming shops, restaurants, and green spaces just a short ride or stroll away, this home delivers the ultimate coastal escape—where every detail is designed to elevate the beach vacation experience.
